description: Changes the look of the whole rack: alternate rails, transparent panels, plainer knobs and jacks, no screws, hidden empty jacks, hidden lights, and a button that packs the modules into neat rows
notes: none of the buttons on this panel is a parameter, so no click on any of them reaches this help; what each one does is set out below
ALT RAILS is the hamburger mark at the top, and its menu holds the alternate rail drawings, a Rail Theme section and Custom rail SVG for a drawing of your own
DERAIL hides the rails, Rack's own as well as any alternate set
NOPANELS makes module panels transparent, leaving knobs, jacks, displays and any other added widgets drawn
CALM swaps Rack's black knobs and jacks for plainer, less glossy ones
UNSCREW takes the screws out of every module using Rack's standard screws; modules with screws of their own are left alone
NOJACK hides every jack with no cable in it, and while they are hidden no new cable can be patched; unplugging a cable leaves that jack visible until the button is used again
DARKNESS hides the lights on every module
PACK'EM packs the modules into left-aligned rows and fills any empty row, keeping each row's modules together so expanders are not separated
PACK'EM works on the selection if there is one, and F7 with the pointer over the module does the same
the round button at the bottom puts the whole rack back to Rack's normal appearance in one click
F6 with the pointer over the module zooms the view to the selected modules; the ? mark shows both keyboard tips
only one Skiff works at a time; a second one added to the patch is drawn greyed out with no controls on it at all
menu: Rack — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: goes back to Rack's own rail drawing
Plain — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Plain drawing
Simple — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Simple drawing
No-hole — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the No-hole drawing
Blank — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Blank drawing
Gradient — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Gradient drawing
Pinstripe — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Pinstripe drawing
Sine — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu at the top: draws the rails from the Sine drawing
Custom rail SVG — in the ALT RAILS hamburger menu: opens an SVG file of your own to use as the rails, best drawn a multiple of 15 pixels wide and 380 pixels high or more
Rail Theme: None, Follow Rack UI theme, Follow Rack prefer dark panels, Light, Dark, High Contrast — recolours the rail drawing; only the light colouring is loaded by this build
Shouting buttons — switches the button lettering between capitals and mixed case
Calm jack shape: Plain, Spades, Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Splat — sets the shape drawn inside a patched jack while CALM is on
